ns2:course.label: Biological Measurement II
ns2:course.description: With special focus on medical imaging, learn about advanced techniques relating to state-of-the-art bioinstrumentation technologies. Topics will broadly include fluorescence, genomic and proteomic diagnostics, biosensors, ultrasound imaging, microscopy and their uses relevant to physiological changes related to major human diseases. Prerequisite: BIOE 571. For students enrolled in the M.Eng in Bioengineering degree program.
